topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: I returned to the place where the old tree stands, the one that marks the path through the woods, just as my own steps had led me long ago. The air is different now, yet the scent of the earth whispers of familiarity. My child, so eager, so full of the morning's light, walks beside me, their pace quickening as we approach the cleared path where the schoolhouse stands. The same building, the same path, and now, the same guide for their journey. I watch as they disappear into the wooden door, a figure emerging to greet them, a figure from my past, eyes twinkling with recognition. My steps slow as I turn to leave, the weight of the day's start lightened. The circle is complete, and the old tree nods in silent agreement.
